summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K (press release) reporting Q1 2026 results and the transfer of its eyewear business to that business's management team. No price per share, premium, or deal value is disclosed; the transaction is described as a portfolio action following the earlier sale of its Rapidfit business. The board recommends the transfer to allow the eyewear business to operate under a setup that best supports its next growth phase. No advisors, break fee, or expected close date are stated. What to watch: further details on consideration and any regulatory approvals; risk-arb angle is limited without disclosed terms.
